⚠ INGLIZ MANZILI — TARTIB:

  Ingliz manzili KIChIKDAN KATTAGA
  yoziladi:

     1) Liberty House — BINO nomi
     2) New Greenham Park — TUMAN/hudud
     3) Newbury — ShAHAR
     4) Berkshire — GRAFLIK (viloyat)
     5) RG19 6HW — POChTA INDEKSI

  ⚠ O'zbek manzili ham shunday: uy →
  ko'cha → tuman → viloyat.


⚠ 'A POSTCODE' (pochta indeksi):

  'RG19 6HW' — Britaniya pochta indeksi.

  Tuzilishi:
     RG   — hudud harfi (Reading)
     19   — tuman raqami
     6HW  — ko'cha va uy guruhi

  ⚠ Britaniyada indeks HARF va RAQAMDAN
  iborat; ko'p mamlakatlarda faqat raqam.


⚠ '(0044)' — MAMLAKAT KODI:

  0044 = Buyuk Britaniya

  ⚠ Hozir odatda '+44' deb yoziladi.
  '00' — xalqaro qo'ng'iroq prefiksi
  (Yevropada).

  Boshqa kodlar:
     +998 — O'zbekiston
     +1   — AQSh va Kanada
     +7   — Rossiya


⚠ 'CO.UK' — DOMEN:

  '.co.uk' = Britaniya tijorat sayti
  '.com' = xalqaro tijorat
  '.org' = tashkilot
  '.edu' = ta'lim muassasasi

  'uk' = United Kingdom (Buyuk Britaniya)


⚠ KITOBDAGI BOSMA XATO:

  Kitobda: 'http: //www.expresspublishing...'
  To'g'ri: 'http://www.expresspublishing...'

  Ikki nuqtadan KEYIN ortiqcha BO'ShLIQ bor.

  ⚠ Workbook 83-betdagi Blockbuster havolasi
  ham xato bosilgan edi ('http/www...').
  Bu kitobda havolalarni yozishda
  ehtiyotsizlik bo'lgan.


DIQQAT — 'TEL.' va 'FAX':
  'Tel.' = telephone (nuqta bilan qisqartma)
  'Fax' = faksimile

  ⚠ FAKS — hujjatni telefon liniyasi orqali
  yuboradigan eski qurilma. Hozir deyarli
  ishlatilmaydi (elektron pochta o'rnini
  egallagan).


DIQQAT — 'INQUIRIES':
  'an inquiry' = so'rov, savol
  'inquiries@...' — savollar uchun manzil

  ⚠ 'inquiry' (AmE) / 'enquiry' (BrE) —
  ikkalasi ham to'g'ri.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:

  an address  = manzil
  a postcode  = pochta indeksi
  a county    = graflik (Britaniya viloyati)
  a country code = mamlakat kodi
  an inquiry  = so'rov, savol
  a fax       = faks

⚠ '©' BELGISI:

  '©' = copyright (mualliflik huquqi)

  'copy' (nusxa) + 'right' (huquq)
  = nusxa ko'chirish huquqi

  Yozilishi: © [egasi], [yil]


⚠ 'ALL RIGHTS RESERVED':

  = 'Barcha huquqlar himoyalangan'

  Turg'un huquqiy ibora — deyarli har
  kitobda bor.

  'to reserve' = saqlab qo'ymoq, band
     qilmoq
  ⚠ Workbook 73-bet: 'to BOOK a table' =
  stol band qilmoq — o'xshash ma'no.


⚠ IKKI SANA — NEGA:

  'First published 1997' — birinchi nashri
  'New edition 2000' — yangi nashri

  Kitob 1997-yilda chiqqan, 2000-yilda
  qayta ishlanib chiqarilgan.

  ⚠ Shuning uchun kitobda 'video cassette'
  va 'Blockbuster' kabi ESKIRGAN
  ma'lumotlar bor (83-bet).

  'an edition' = nashr
  'a new edition' = yangi nashr


⚠ HUQUQIY MATNDAGI GRAMMATIKA:

  'No part ... MAY BE REPRODUCED, STORED
   ... or TRANSMITTED ...'

  ⚠ MAJHUL nisbat + 'may':
     'may be reproduced' = ko'paytirilishi
        mumkin
     'may be stored' = saqlanishi mumkin
     'may be transmitted' = uzatilishi
        mumkin

  'NO part ... may be ...' = hech bir qismi
  ... mumkin emas (INKOR ma'no).

  All rights reserved = barcha huquqlar
                himoyalangan

  prior       = oldingi
  an edition  = nashr
  design      = dizayn
  illustration = rasm, tasvir

BETNING UChINChI QISMI — MINNATDORChILIK.


TO'LIQ MATN:

  'The authors and publishers wish to thank
   the following who have kindly given
   permission for the use of copyright
   material.

   Audio Visual for the photographs of
   Pocahontas © Disney, The Hunchback of
   Notre Dame © Disney, Mary Poppins ©
   Disney, The Lion King © Disney

   Colour Illustrations: Terry Wilson

   Every effort has been made to trace all
   the copyright holders but if any have
   been inadvertently overlooked, the
   publishers will be pleased to make the
   necessary arrangements at the first
   opportunity.'


TARJIMASI:

  'Mualliflar va nashriyot mualliflik huquqi
   himoyalangan materiallardan foydalanishga
   xayrixohlik bilan ruxsat berganlarga
   minnatdorchilik bildiradi.

   Pokaxontas, Notr-Dam bukri, Meri Poppins
   va Sher qirol filmlaridan suratlar uchun —
   Audio Visual, © Disney.

   Rangli rasmlar: Terri Uilson.

   Barcha mualliflik huquqi egalarini topishga
   harakat qilindi, lekin kimdir beixtiyor
   e'tibordan chetda qolgan bo'lsa, nashriyot
   birinchi imkoniyatdayoq zarur choralarni
   ko'rishdan mamnun bo'ladi.'


⚠ TO'RTTA DISNEY FILMI:

  Minnatdorchilikda AYNAN to'rtta film
  tilga olingan:

     • Pocahontas          (88-bet)
     • The Hunchback of
       Notre Dame          (84-bet)
     • Mary Poppins        (85-bet)
     • The Lion King       (86-bet)

  ⚠ 'HIGHLANDER' (87-bet) RO'YXATDA YO'Q!

  Sababi: Highlander — Disney filmi EMAS,
  boshqa studiya mahsuloti. Uning surati
  ham boshqa manbadan olingan.

  ⚠ Bu — kitobning ichki mantiqi: faqat
  suratdan foydalanilgan film egalariga
  rahmat aytiladi.


⚠ 'ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS' — QIYIN SO'Z:

  'to acknowledge' = tan olmoq, e'tirof
     etmoq
  'acknowledgements' = minnatdorchilik
     (kitobda)

  ⚠ YOZILIShI: acknowledgeMENTs
  (BrE) yoki acknowledgMENTs (AmE) —
  'e' bor yoki yo'q.

  ⚠ TALAFFUZ: /əkˈnɒlɪdʒmənts/ —
  boshidagi 'ac-' /ək/ deb o'qiladi.


⚠ GRAMMATIKA — 'WISH TO':

  'The authors WISH TO THANK ...'
  = mualliflar rahmat aytmoqchi

  ⚠ 'wish to' — RASMIY shakl.
  Kundalik nutqda: 'want to'.

     'I WISH TO thank you.'  (rasmiy)
     'I WANT TO thank you.'  (oddiy)


⚠ GRAMMATIKA — PRESENT PERFECT:

  'who HAVE kindly GIVEN permission'
  'Every effort HAS BEEN MADE ...'
  'if any HAVE BEEN inadvertently
   overlooked'

  ⚠ Uchalasi ham Present Perfect —
  natijasi HOZIR muhim.

  ⚠ 'has been made' va 'have been
  overlooked' — MAJHUL Present Perfect.


DIQQAT — 'KINDLY':
  'kindly' = xayrixohlik bilan, mehribonlik
     bilan

  'kind' (mehribon) + '-ly' = ravish

  ⚠ Rasmiy matnlarda ko'p ishlatiladi.


DIQQAT — 'INADVERTENTLY':
  'inadvertently' = beixtiyor, bilmasdan

  ⚠ 'in-' — inkor prefiksi
  ('advertent' = diqqatli)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  acknowledgements = minnatdorchilik
  to acknowledge = tan olmoq
  to thank    = rahmat aytmoq
  kindly      = xayrixohlik bilan
  permission  = ruxsat
  material    = material
  a photograph = surat
  an illustration = rasm
  an effort   = harakat
  to trace    = topmoq, izlab topmoq
  a copyright holder = huquq egasi
  inadvertently = beixtiyor
  to overlook = e'tibordan chetda qoldirmoq
  an arrangement = tadbir, kelishuv
  an opportunity = imkoniyat
